name: Hana
source:
Market Price: 10,000 JPY to 20,000 JPY

A high school girl with braids who enjoys "toilet prostitution". She's cute like a small animal. Unintentionally, she sometimes snags customers on some other girl's turf, and because of this, she doesn't have an established place of business.

For some reason, she keeps her surname a secret. 

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=863865]Getchu[/url]]
